 Anselmi and Aguirre set for first touchline meeting in Elche Valencia derby 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Martín Anselmi and Javier Aguirre finally meet on the touchline this afternoon, Elche hosting Valencia at the Martínez Valero. They have never faced each other, yet they know each other well.
 According to AS, the pair overlapped in Mexico between late 2024 and early 2025, Aguirre coaching El Tri while Anselmi led Cruz Azul.
 OneFootball Videos
 Aguirre repeatedly highlighted Cruz Azul’s football at the time, describing it as a pleasure to watch. During Anselmi’s tenure, six Cruz Azul players received Mexico call-ups from Aguirre.
 On the eve of the derby, Aguirre said he knows Anselmi well from Mexico and called him a very good coach. He felt Elche took time to settle but have improved to a high level, and warned of their sharp play inside. He stressed the match’s importance.
 Anselmi, for his part, credited Aguirre with giving his team the freedom it needed. He noted that has not yet translated into wins, though the side are competing strongly. Both managers will discover this afternoon who has studied the rival better.
 Source: AS
